title: Marc Fixes Things
brand: built by I.Magin · draft for Marc
headline: The guy who fixes things lives in the building.
subhead: 507 homes, and the person who can hang the shelf, chase the leak and finish the job the contractor abandoned is already inside the gate. This is his page — his to approve, and empty until he does.

sections.heading: Why in-building beats a search result
items: A handyman found online quotes a callout, a drive, and a window between eleven and three. A handyman on the fourth floor is up in ten minutes and there is no drive to pay for.
That is not a small advantage. It is the whole business, and it only works if the people in this building know he exists — which today they mostly don't.

This page fixes exactly that, and the QR board downstairs does the rest. Nothing here states a licence, a rate or an insurance status: those are Marc's to give, and a handyman page that guesses at them is worse than no page at all.

items.name: This page, finished and live
items.note: One page, his real work photographed, his number on it, and his slot on the resident board.

items.name: The full setup
items.note: A proper site, a request form that reaches his phone, and a Google Business profile so he shows up on the map, not just in the elevator.

items.name: Kept current
items.note: New jobs photographed and posted, seasonal work promoted. Cancel any month.

sections.heading: Next step
sections.title: Six answers and six photos.
sections.note: Trades, years, licence and insurance, callout, hourly, hours. Bring the photos from the last job you were proud of. Nothing goes public under Marc's name until Marc says yes.

footer_notes: This is an unpublished draft made to show Marc what his page would look like. It makes no claim about his licensing, insurance, rates or availability.
